title: Easy Smoky Croatian Bread Toast
description: A delicious and easy to make Croatian dish featuring stale bread, perfect for a snack or light meal, with a smoky flavor and yeasty texture, it is also plant-based-friendly.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees Fahrenheit.
Slice the stale bread into 1 inch thick slices.
Place the bread slices on a baking sheet lined with parchment paper.
Drizzle the olive oil over the bread slices.
Sprinkle the smoked paprika, garlic powder, salt, and black pepper over the bread slices.
Bake the bread in the preheated oven for 10 minutes, or until lightly toasted.
Remove the bread from the oven and sprinkle with chopped fresh parsley.
Drizzle the lemon juice over the bread slices.
Serve the smoky Croatian bread toast warm and enjoy.
